title: New twelve-task broad-corpus comparison
description: Six complete-bundle replicates on twelve tasks never used in the prior seed, pilot, arithmetic-vocabulary, or broad workload, after the general v0.3.154 checker-totality correction.

corpus_boundary.purpose: Estimate broad agent reliability and effort without reusing the eight tasks that informed iterations 016–020.

primary_gate.correctness: Parley hidden-task success must be 100% and no lower than either baseline.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley median reported total tokens per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley median elapsed seconds per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley first-check task success rate must be no lower than the higher Python/Rust rate.
primary_gate.verdict: All four conditions must hold for strict broad-corpus parity.

secondary_analysis: Report every session and all 216 task outcomes, including failures and outliers.
Report medians, ranges, repair-free sensitivity, first-check task and bundle rates, repairs, prompt size, protocol compliance, and hidden correctness.
Classify every Parley first-check and hidden failure before considering any language change.
Separate parser/checker/backend defects, algorithm errors, unfamiliar existing features, and unsupported phrasings.
Compare with iteration 020 descriptively only because both the corpus and sessions are new.
feature_boundary: The compiler is frozen at v0.3.154. The only change after iteration 020 is selective mutable Rust emission for loop variables the checker already permitted agents to change; there is no new syntax, checker rule, runtime operation, or instruction text.
change_rule: Do not add syntax or compiler behavior from one task, transcript, or token gap. Any proposal requires recurrence across unrelated tasks plus independent general usefulness, semantic consistency, and maintainability. Checker-totality defects remain correctness bugs and may be fixed without claiming a benchmark improvement.
instruction_rule: The proven 1,519-character Parley skill is injected once per session and remains byte-for-byte unchanged. No further instruction-compression experiment is permitted.
stop_rule: Preserve the complete result even if parity fails. Do not tune against these twelve tasks after observing output; the next comparison must use another independently frozen corpus or model split unless a separately justified correctness fix requires exact regression replay.
